results.title: Epitaph
results.overview: A solitary young woman living with her dog becomes the target of neighbourhood slander. Her sudden suicide—and the earlier discovery of a dead foetus—fuels harsher speculation. Two neighbouring families, a young couple and an elderly father with his bedridden daughter, confront their own fears while discussing her fate. Her ambiguous life and death expose a society quick to judge independent women yet capable of rare empathy.

results.title: The Bistro
results.overview: One summer, a twelve-year-old girl works at her grandma's bistro, full of strange adults.

results.title: AKIAK
results.overview: A young indigenous woman in 1860's Alaska crosses paths with an injured bandit, who is being hunted by someone from the woman's past.

results.title: Forged in Fire
results.overview: During youth fire brigade training, Mila and Amélie’s friendship grows.

results.title: River Warrior
results.overview: After enduring a four-year drought, an off-grid farmer embarks on a kayaking journey from her hometown creek in Appalachia all the way to the Gulf—seeking to reconnect with and redefine her relationship to water.

results.title: Beyond
results.overview: Follows people living with and beyond cancer as they discover strength, connection, and a new sense of possibility through climbing. Set between indoor walls and wild mountain rock, it is a powerful story about recovery becoming adventure.

results.title: The Glorious Dead
results.overview: A small-town sheriff and her deputy awaken to a changed world where blood drips from taps, people and pets vanish, fleshy creatures roam the woods, and the hamlet descends into chaos. By noon, the skies turn white with snow, and the dirt cannot keep the dead down as the shattered community buckles under the pressure, and as the sun sets, all hell has frozen over.

results.title: CAPTURED
results.overview: Andy, a stressed and obsessive wildlife photographer desperate for a competition-winning shot, sets out alone into the woods where his anxiety, lack of medication, and mounting frustration blur the line between ambition and self-destruction.

results.title: The Daughter of Lady Fairy
results.overview: A sound designer working on a film's dubbing, a young woman returns to confront her former lover after years of absence. Her unexpected return revives old memories, confronting him with unresolved emotions and painful truths from the past. As his mother lies in a coma, he finds himself caught between duty and desire, forced to choose between staying by her side or rekindling the love he once lost. Suspended between memory and reality, past and present, he must face a decision that will shape the course of his future.

results.title: La Percée
results.overview: An 11-year-old boy is preparing for his performance at the end-of-year show. But he gets stage fright and spills something on his costume. He runs off to wash the stain out and embarks on a journey of self-discovery that, after many detours, gives him new self-confidence.

results.title: ChikaBOOM!!
results.overview: Chika Batstone is an aspiring young magician whose curiosity accidentally unleashes Kaboom, a chaotic magical creature, into the heart of New York City.

results.title: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
results.overview: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

results.title: Miralles
results.overview: The film Miralles tells, as in a novel, the vision of the world of one of the most important Spanish architects of the contemporary international scene.  Enric Miralles dies at the age of 45 from a brain tumor. The next day he is buried in his masterpiece, the Igualada Cemetery, an unfinished forest-cemetery. From that moment on, his life and his work are inextricably linked.  The film unfolds in variations, following Miralles' own creative method inspired by Giacometti. A search without the possibility of conclusions, as in the extraordinary and complex Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh, one of the architect's last works and also one of his magisterial works.

results.title: The Cure - Rock Werchter 2026
results.overview: The Cure headlined and closed ⁠Rock Werchter 2026 on Sunday, July 5, 2026, with a grand, generous and intense concert performing a massive career-spanning set as the final act of the four-day festival in Werchter, Belgium. Since their first appearance at the Festivalpark in 1981, the iconic British band has played several legendary concerts in Werchter. Few bands manage to remain both relevant and beloved for nearly five decades. The Cure continues to reach and inspire generations.

results.title: Baby Fever
results.overview: A woman struggles to control her transformation into a baby-eating monster at her best friend's baby shower.

results.title: Granny DJ
results.overview: Granny DJ is forced to confront a horde of demented creatures, spawned by her own inner demons, in a daring quest to save her beloved granddaughter.

results.title: A Colisão dos Destinos
results.overview: From childhood to the presidency of Brazil, the documentary follows Jair Bolsonaro’s trajectory, tracing his background, military career, and the path that led to his political rise.

results.title: Donation Box
results.overview: A late night clothing donation takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: Orang Minyak
results.overview: Rayyan reluctantly spends his 16th birthday at the beach. When he suddenly finds oil stains on his body, he becomes convinced that a mysterious entity is stalking him.
